artworks.title: Cassandra
artworks.description: De Morgan's prophetess before the burning city — she tears at her flame-red hair as everything she foretold comes true and no one will listen.

artworks.title: The Murder of Agamemnon
artworks.description: Guérin stages the Mycenaean slaughter — Cassandra's doom beside the king in the bath, the long memory of Iphigenia, and Clytemnestra's axe.

artworks.title: Cassandra
artworks.description: Sandys' head of the seer — wide-eyed prophecy at the moment Troy falls, the curse Apollo set on her voice made visible.
